Reason: The chest radiograph shows a small, hyperlucent right hemithorax with an elevated right hemidiaphragm and mediastinal shift to the right, which are classic features of hypogenetic lung syndrome (scimitar syndrome). This congenital anomaly is frequently associated with recurrent lung infections and other midline defects like laryngomalacia.
